title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.105.0, contain an Improper Restriction… (CVE-2026-111518)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.105.0 have an improper restriction of rendered UI layers or frames vulnerability. This flaw could be exploited by a high privileged attacker with remote access to cause denial of service and potentially launch phishing attacks. The vulnerability has a low CVSS score of 3.1, indicating limited impact and exploitability.
